topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; confidentiality agreement for dispatchers; no security-specific commitment
Majority owner approves the security budget and High risks; no recurring security oversight meeting yet
remediation: Quarterly security review by the owner and COO

control_description: Security Officer and Privacy Officer designated in writing; reporting lines in POL-01
Background, driving record, and certification checks at hire; security training only at hire
Policies assign accountability; sanctions not yet applied in practice
Inventories incomplete (MDCs, vehicle routers, cardiac monitors, network gear)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved; not yet communicated to crews or acknowledged
gap: No acknowledgments; crews cannot reach policies from the field
remediation: Collect acknowledgments; publish to the crew portal

control_description: County PSAP and hospital contacts exist for operations; no security contact or incident notice terms with the county
gap: No security communication terms with the county or facilities
remediation: Security contact and incident notice terms in the county interface agreement

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance defined in POL-01 and P01
2026 risk analysis per SP 800-30 (P01)
Billing upcoding and CAD time-edit risks identified (R-028, R-029); no broader fraud assessment
remediation: Add payment diversion and supply theft to the next analysis

control_description: Change triggers defined in POL-01; no change process yet (for example, the AI module was enabled without review)
gap: Significant changes not assessed before they happen
remediation: Change log with security review for new features and feeds

control_description: First control assessment 2026-08 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP; many planned
General IT controls partly implemented; CAD server and consoles lack baselines

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved; procedures not yet written

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for ePCR, billing, and email; CAD on shared local accounts; flat headquarters network
gap: Shared CAD accounts with no MFA; flat network

control_description: Manager-approved onboarding; no access reviews
Late removal for field staff; billing edit rights; broad recording access
Badge access at headquarters and the dispatch room; shared keypad code at Station 2
Paper shredding certified; tablet and drive wipes unrecorded

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls; VPN only; cloud rules limit inbound traffic; 3 routers exposed management until 2026-08-14

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and VPN in place; some facility email unencrypted; consoles and desktops unencrypted

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Signature antivirus; no EDR; alerts unmonitored
gap: No EDR or alert monitoring on the systems that run dispatch

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scanning; no configuration monitoring

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring or log review
POL-03 defines triage; not yet operated
Runbook approved (P08); untested
Manual dispatch binder; no tested recovery; backups exposed
No change management process; CAD vendor updates applied without a test plan
remediation: Change log and approvals with a CAD test step

control_description: BIA done; no contingency plan or alternate dispatch site
gap: No contingency plan or alternate site

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Hosted phone vendor lacks a BAA; AI service unreviewed; ePCR vendor SOC 2 reviewed 2026-08-21 (Part B)
